The '''Bontormia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Bortele sector/Legends|Bortele sector]], within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="Slice" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Bontormian klesplong/Legends|Bontormian klesplong]] musical instrument.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|85|Bontormian klesplong}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Bontormian klesplong/Legends|Bontormian klesplong]]|system=Bontormia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Bontormia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square R-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
